title: SIAS Login Process
query: How can I log in to SIAS using the Student option at BukSU?

en: To log in to SIAS, open https://sias.buksu.edu.ph/sias/.
Click Student if you are a student. Choose the correct role if you are an instructor or another user type.
Type your Student ID and password, then click Login.
ceb: Para mag-login sa SIAS, ablihi ang https://sias.buksu.edu.ph/sias/.
I-click ang Student kung estudyante ka. Pilia ang sakto nga role kung instructor ka o lain nga user type.
I-type ang imong Student ID ug password, dayon i-click ang Login.
